Accent.$description: Decorative accent shapes. Not for text.

Borders.$description: Input and control borders. Meets 3:1 against Surfaces/Primary. Use Divider for decorative card edges.

Divider.$description: Hairline separators between list rows and sections. Decorative only.

Accent-text.$description: Accent text and secondary emphasis. Meets 4.5:1. Never used for errors.

Muted-text.$description: Timestamps, captions, helper text. Meets 4.5:1 on Primary and Secondary surfaces.

Positive.$description: Icon and inline text for success and confirmation. Always pair with an icon.

Positive-surface.$description: Container background for success and confirmation (banners, toasts, field messages).

Positive-on-surface.$description: Text and icon inside a positive container.

Warning.$description: Icon and inline text for warnings. Always pair with an icon.

Warning-surface.$description: Container background for warnings (banners, toasts, field messages).

Warning-on-surface.$description: Text and icon inside a warning container.

Error.$description: Icon and inline text for errors. Always pair with an icon.

Error-surface.$description: Container background for errors (banners, toasts, field messages).

Error-on-surface.$description: Text and icon inside a error container.

Text-secondary.$description: Running heads, chapter numbers, position labels.

Sand.$description: Private highlight fill (Sand). Reader/Text stays readable on top.

Aqua.$description: Private highlight fill (Aqua). Reader/Text stays readable on top.

Rose.$description: Private highlight fill (Rose). Reader/Text stays readable on top.

Mint.$description: Private highlight fill (Mint). Reader/Text stays readable on top.

Lavender.$description: Private highlight fill (Lavender). Reader/Text stays readable on top.

Reaction.$description: Marker for other members' reactions in the margin.

Thread.$description: Reply and new-reply indicator on a reaction.

Ahead.$description: The ahead-of-you hint. Quiet by design.

Scrim.$description: Dims content behind sheets and dialogs. Raw value: BrandSecondary/BackgroundBlack at 48% opacity (opacity cannot be carried by an alias).

Veil.$description: Spoiler veil over chat messages, voice notes and quote cards.

Veil-text.$description: Text on the spoiler veil (e.g. 'Ada is in Chapter 9').

Recording.$description: Recording indicator. Always shown with a 'REC' label.

Founding-host-text.$description: Text and icon on the Founding Host badge.

Author.$description: Author badge next to a name in the margin.

Track.$description: Progress track and Lobby position rail.

Fill.$description: Progress fill and member position markers.
